_comment: Career map sections (S2-94, documents/architecture/career-map-chronology-design-2026-11-19.md §3.3). Read only by utils/career_chronology.js. A node goes to the FIRST section whose labels it carries (so a Project+Hackathon is a hackathon, a Project+ThoughtLeadership is thought leadership). Employers are nodes with `employer_label`; items under an employer come from the node's `employer` field (MCP: (Company)-[:CONTAINS]->(item) or (item)-[:AT]->(Company)). Every list is newest first. Adding a label is a data change here, not code.
